annotations.title: Get one book from my library

description: Which of up to 25 books the signed-in reader already has on a shelf, and for each one the shelf, their rating and their progress. Takes titles ("Title by Author" resolves best) or workIds. Suits "have I read X", "which of these have I read" and checking a list of book suggestions against what the reader has already read. Titles not in the catalog come back under unmatched. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

books.description: Work ids, siftivo.com slugs, or titles, optionally "Title by Author"
